All 8 items form a continuous Gemara discussion about why the Mishnah specifies 'if they wished' (mai irya ratzu), Rabbi Asi/Yochanan's answer about a courtyard not subject to compelled division, the retraction problem (nahadru behu), and the kinyan resolution — exactly the content described in the 'Kinyan Devarim' prose, which traces this precise chain of questions and answers.
